label: D1 before an upcoming a2 choice, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at D2, about 12 GO steps total). It fires almost exclusively when the agent is about to choose a2 (99.4% of mass at D1 with upcoming action a2, and also mostly after a previous a2 choice), so it encodes the agent's own upcoming / ongoing a2 preference, which is a legitimate computed quantity rather than an unobservable outcome. It is strongly gated by episode time: essentially silent in trials 0-20, rising steadily to a lift of 3.4x in trials 90-99. It is also concentrated where the value-head output is low (<7.1 holds about 87% of mass) and where the D1 policy logit mildly favours a2 (choice -4.4..-1.5). D1 & upcoming a2 alone gives recall 0.98 but precision 0.12; adding ep_trial>=50 gives mass recall 0.96, precision 0.22; the recorded ep_trial>=70 version trades to F1 0.42, mass recall 0.82. Within the predicate it fires sparsely and irregularly across consecutive a2 trials, and no tested reward/transition/stay condition sharpened it, so precision stays low (~0.3). It does not depend much on the reward or transition of the previous trial (prev_reward 1 shows a mild input lift only because rewarded inputs are common). Recorded predicate uses action at D1 (the agent's own upcoming choice, which is allowed).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D1 & last=a2 S2 u (+2.85), phase=D1 & before=a2 S1 u (+2.84), phase=GO & before=a1 S1 r (+2.45), phase=D1 & choice_bin=decile 1 (9 = most a1) (+2.16), last=a2 S1 r (+1.42), phase=D1 & ep_dec=4 (+1.33). Lower it: phase=D2 (-5.95), prev_action=1 (-5.26), phase=GO (-4.48), before=a1 S2 r (-3.92).
